verses.1: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.2: I speak to the children of Israel, and I say to them: “I, Jehovah your God, am with you.”
verses.3: As the Egyptians did, do not do those things there. And as the people of Canaan did, when I bring you to them, do not do those things either. And according to their laws, do not go there.
verses.4: You shall carry out my judgments, and you shall keep my laws. Then I, the LORD your God, will be with you always.
verses.5: And you shall keep my laws and decrees. These are the laws that men must obey in order to live. I, the LORD, am the one who gives them these laws.
verses.6: Everyone, in their own words, shall not approach to speak evil of others. I am the LORD.
verses.7: Do not reveal the hatred of your father and the hatred of your mother. Do not show them their hatred.
verses.8: Do not show the hatred of your father’s wife. Do not let your father’s hatred be revealed.
verses.9: Do not show any hatred towards your sister, whether she is the daughter of your father or the daughter of your mother. She may be born in the same house as you, but do not show any hatred toward her.
verses.10: Do not show any hatred towards your daughter or your daughters. Your hatred is already known to them.
verses.11: The shame of your mother’s daughter is born from your father. Your sister, do not reveal her shame.
verses.12: Do not reveal the shame of your brother to your other father.
verses.13: Do not show any hatred towards your mother’s sisters, since your mother herself is also one of them.
verses.14: Do not reveal the shame of your father to his wife. Do not approach your mother in that manner.
verses.15: Do not reveal the evil of your daughter. She is not worthy of being revealed as evil.
verses.16: Do not show any hatred towards your brother’s wife. Do not show any disdain for your brother.
verses.17: A woman’s shame and her daughters should not be revealed. She should not reveal her daughters’ shame, nor should she bring shame upon her own daughters. Let this shame remain hidden for now.
verses.18: And a woman shall not take her sister as a companion for the purpose of spreading her evil reputation upon her during her lifetime.
verses.19: And a woman with a leprous skin disease shall not approach to reveal her disgrace.
verses.20: And do not give your wife to another man as a wife, so that she may become his concubine.
verses.21: And from your seed, you shall not allow anyone to become king. Nor shall you profane the name of your God. I, Jehovah, am God.
verses.22: And let not his memory be forgotten from the beds of women. It is a disgraceful thing to do.
verses.23: And in every animal, you shall not lay your bed on its back. And a woman shall not stand before an animal to examine it. The tallow is forbidden for that purpose.
verses.24: Do not bury them all together. For in all of them are buried those nations whom I have sent from before you.
verses.25: And the earth became dark, and its surface was covered with darkness. The earth became uninhabitable for people to live on.
verses.26: And you shall keep my laws and decrees. You shall not practice any of these oppressive practices among your people.
verses.27: For all these hardships, it was the people of the land who caused them. The land itself has been defiled because of them.
verses.28: And the earth will not be able to swallow you up during your journey, just as it did with the people who lived before you.
verses.29: For whatever is done in response to all these hardships, it will be recorded in the records of those who suffer.
verses.30: And you shall keep my commandments, so that you may not commit the sins that were done before you. And do not go astray in them. I, the LORD your God, will be your God.
